methodology: Only state Finance Department and GAD entries evidenced by direct 2026 register pages. This is a verified register subset, not exhaustive departmental collection. Cabinet decisions and out-of-window statutes are not counted as circulars. Headline translation into English may be abbreviated. Source-quality correction 18 Nov: excluded GAD rule RULE/297/2025-GAD-3 because its original circular was issued 24 December 2025 despite a 14 September 2026 register date; publication and issuance dates are not interchangeable.
